title: The door
notTheirs: Your role on this event can’t see the door. Ask the event’s owner to add you as a coordinator.

counts.label: Who has arrived
counts.failed: The counts couldn’t be read. Trying again.
counts.refused: Your role can’t see the counts.
counts.asOf: As of {{time}}. The latest read failed; trying again.

find.label: Find a guest
find.noMatch: Nobody on the list by that name.
find.capped: Only the first {{count}} are shown. Type more of the name.

list.loading: Reading the guest list… Ticket codes work meanwhile.
list.refused: Your role can’t see the guest list.
list.failed: The guest list couldn’t be read.
list.empty: No guests on the list yet. Ticket codes still work.
list.partial: Only the first {{count, number}} guests were read: someone further on won’t be found by name. Ticket codes still work.
list.asOf: This is the list from {{time}}: reading it again failed.

code.label: Ticket code
code.empty: Type the code from their ticket.
code.notLatin: That isn’t Latin letters. Switch the keyboard to English and type the code again.

mustAgree.title: Must agree before the door ({{count}})
mustAgree.lead: They can’t be let in until they agree, from their invitation’s link on their own phone. Nobody can agree for them here.
mustAgree.partial: This list may not be whole: some here may already have agreed. The door checks each person.
mustAgree.none: Nobody who is coming still has to agree.
mustAgree.unread: Who still has to agree couldn’t be read. The door still checks each person.

result.notExpected: They weren’t expected: they declined or never answered. Worth telling the host.
result.unlinked: Ticket admitted at {{time}}. It has no guest linked, so it isn’t in the counts and can’t be undone here.
result.earlierPress: Probably your earlier press, whose answer didn’t come through.
result.ticketUsed: This ticket has already been admitted. A code admits once.
result.ticketUsedAt: This ticket was admitted at {{time}}. A code admits once.
result.undone: Taken off the arrivals. They can be checked in again.
result.addedNotHere: Added to the guest list, but not checked in yet.

refused.mustAgree: Not let in yet: they still have to agree to the hosts’ statement, from their invitation’s link on their own phone. Nobody can agree for them here.
refused.registerFirst: Not let in yet: this ticket names nobody, and the event requires an agreement. Ask the host to register who holds it.
refused.ticketVoid: Don’t let them in: this ticket is void. Send them to the host.
refused.ticketRefunded: Don’t let them in: this ticket was refunded. Send them to the host.
refused.orderClosed: Don’t let them in: this ticket’s order was cancelled or refunded, or is being cancelled. Send them to the host.
refused.orderCancelled: Don’t let them in: this ticket’s order was cancelled. Send them to the host.
refused.orderRefunded: Don’t let them in: this ticket’s order was refunded. Send them to the host.
refused.orderExpired: Don’t let them in: this ticket’s order was never paid. Send them to the host.
refused.orderCancelling: Don’t let them in: this ticket’s order is being cancelled. Send them to the host.
refused.notRecognised: This code isn’t recognised for this event. Check it letter by letter; if it’s right, send them to the host.
refused.linkChanged: This ticket’s link to a guest changed just now. The list is being read again: press again.
refused.guestGone: This guest is no longer on the list. The list is being read again.
refused.forbidden: Your role on this event can’t let people in. Ask the event’s owner to add you as a coordinator.
refused.rateLimited: Too many tries just now. Wait a moment and press again.
refused.noAnswer: No answer came. It may have counted: press again, which is safe.

walkIn.help: They are added to the guest list in a household of their own, with one seat, and checked in. Anyone with them is added the same way.
walkIn.mayBeAdded: No answer came, so they may have been added all the same. Search for them above before adding them again.

scan.hint: Hold the ticket’s code in the frame. It is read by itself.
scan.notTicket: That code isn’t a ticket, so nothing was sent.

problem.refused: The camera isn’t allowed. Allow it in the browser’s settings, or type the code below.
problem.none: This device has no camera to use. Please type the code below.
problem.busy: The camera couldn’t open or stopped, perhaps in use elsewhere. Try again, or type the code below.
problem.insecure: The camera only opens on a secure page. Please type the code below.
problem.noReader: The scanner couldn’t be loaded. Reload the page once the connection is back, or type the code below.
